.armorer/ci-policy.toml.content:
# Owner-approved pilot adoption 2026-11-21 (Veans #36). ci-policy-v1 for brianluby/momus-review.
# Momus has NO cargo-deny today (release gate is scripts/audit.sh, cargo-audit
# 0.22.2, empty scripts/audit-exceptions.txt). This policy is NEW protection,
# not a migration. License allowlist derived from the observed all-features
# dependency closure (cargo-deny 0.19.7 list, offline, 1.98.1, 2026-11-12):
#   MIT(141) Apache-2.0(115) Unicode-3.0(19) ISC(5) BSD-3-Clause(2)
#   Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception(1) CDLA-Permissive-2.0(1)
#   Unlicense(3: aho-corasick/memchr/bstr, all "Unlicense OR MIT")
#   BSL-1.0(1: ryu, "Apache-2.0 OR BSL-1.0")
# Permissive-only, matching sibling pilot rusty-brain's deny.toml stance.
# No copyleft accepted. Owner must approve every token.
schema_version = 1

[licenses]
allow = [
    "MIT",
    "Apache-2.0",
    "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception",
    "BSD-3-Clause",
    "ISC",
    "Unicode-3.0",
    "CDLA-Permissive-2.0",
    "Unlicense",
    "BSL-1.0",
]

[advisories]
# Matches scripts/audit-exceptions.txt today: empty. Any future exception needs
# owner + reason + ISO UTC expiry within 90 days (ci_policy.rs parse_at).
exceptions = []

[sources]
# crates.io only; momus Cargo.toml has no git dependencies (verified).
allow_git = []

[bans]
multiple_versions = "warn"
deny = []

.github/workflows/armorer-build.yml.content:
name: Armorer unsigned build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: armorer-build-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    uses: brianluby/armorer-workflows/.github/workflows/rust-build.yml@e5e9c0d31baff87e357046d81068b646a39a9f23

.github/workflows/armorer-ci.yml.content:
name: Armorer CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: armorer-ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  verify:
    uses: brianluby/armorer-workflows/.github/workflows/rust-ci.yml@e5e9c0d31baff87e357046d81068b646a39a9f23
